detail: raw exception normalised to UNEXPECTED_ERROR: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading '-1')
note: det of a 0x0 matrix. `isSquare` accepts it, and the integer route ended by reading `rows[n - 1][n - 1]`, so it read `rows[-1]` and leaked a TypeError. It returns the empty product, 1, which is what the numeric and symbolic routes already returned for the same matrix. No source can build one: a literal `[]` is refused for having no shape.
